## Problem and use case

Who encounters this problem, and what are they trying to accomplish?

## Proposed behavior

Give a concrete example of the desired result and any alternatives considered.

## Scope and validation

Link related issues and the relevant ROADMAP.md or progress/SCOPE.md decision.
Explain how the behavior could be verified and whether it changes source formats,
protocols, dependencies or hosting. Proposals do not automatically change v1 scope;
discuss substantial features before implementation.
